thesis: The episode discusses GPT3, a generative pre-trained transformer model released by OpenAI, which functions as a text predictor capable of performing tasks like arithmetic and generating code without specific retraining. The speakers explain that OpenAI provides access to this model via an API rather than distributing the raw model to lower the barrier to entry and manage responsible use.
